card.name: Word starting with In- or incom-
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word that begins with "In" or "incom" (Instruct, Invert, incompletely) or "in" before "accordance". It fires when the word is split and the rest follows.

modes.label: In- at word start
modes.description: Capitalized "In" opening a word like Instruct or Invert.
modes.example: Instruct the Patient to Exhale<< In>>struct the patient to hold the inhaler

modes.label: incom- in incompletely
modes.description: The piece "incom" before "pletely" in the NSAID anemia sentence.
modes.example: or an<< incom>>pletely described effect on erythropoies

modes.label: in before accordance
modes.description: The word "in" after "interrupt" in dose adjustment text.
modes.example: reduce the dose to the next lower level or interrupt<< in>> accordance with the table below
